title: Classified video meeting: smiling official says it may not be from our planet

plain: During a secret video meeting in 2025, an official smiled and suggested the objects might not be from our planet, according to James Valor of Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call UFOs into view. Valor says he was in the meeting, held over video "in secret mode," and that the man on the screen "a little smiled." He tells it as a hint that people with access to classified information think the objects may be from somewhere else.
